name: windy-plugin-snowline-map-100m
description: ECMWF wet-bulb-zero Snowline proxy to +144 h with Label only, Contour only, and Label + contour modes, Follow Windy picker control, automatic label hiding, ±100 m near-snowline wording, 3-hour snowline tendency, precipitation-gated output, adaptive contour spacing by zoom, Windy map elevation, caching and decluttered contours.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && SERVE=false rollup -c && cp package.json dist/
scripts.build:win: rmdir /s /q dist && mkdir dist && set SERVE=false && rollup -c && copy package.json dist\
